method: Own DESI DR1 Gaussian BAO likelihood, alpha = c/(H0 r_d) marginalised (conventions.json bao), joint grid posteriors
text: DESI DR1 BAO (r_d prior 147.31 +- 0.31): BAO alone shows a mild preference for evolving DE; DESI+Pantheon+: the Planck LCDM point touches the 1 sigma contours in all three projections; DESI+DES5Y: contours displaced, high Omega_m from DES5Y disfavoured by BAO, and the ~3 sigma evidence for dynamical DE in the lower panel is driven by DES5Y.
rests_on: Conclusions l.556-557: 'DESI BAO combined with Pantheon+ SN are consistent with LCDM'
revision_note: Location only: figure numbers corrected to the TeX caption order (PROTOCOL Addendum A2). Statement, method and criteria unchanged from r1.
